newsitem.title: CHINA: Deng's Beijing home tightly guarded by police.
newsitem.headline: Deng's Beijing home tightly guarded by police.

text.p: Police have thrown a security blanket around the Beijing home of China's late paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, witnesses said on Thursday.
Policemen kept traffic flowing along Di'anmen Avenue, the main road leading toward Deng's home, and prevented passers-by from pausing outside his compound.
Police even turned away some mourners who arrived carrying wreaths of fresh flowers and manned street corners in the district in an unusual display of security.
Curious cyclists slowed down as they rode past the heavily guarded alley leading to Deng's home.
